description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (1.50 each), grants [Magical Quick Cast], [Buff Fire 20% (15s)], and [Buff Earth 20% (15s)] to all allies, grants [Awoken Successor], [Twin Element Mode II (Fire, Earth)] and [Damage Cap +10000] to the user

description.name: Magical Quick Cast
description.text: Cast speed x2.00 for BLK, WHT, BLU, SUM or NAT attacks that deal magical damage

description.name: Buff Fire 20% (15s)
description.text: Increases Fire damage dealt by 20%, cumulable

description.name: Buff Earth 20% (15s)
description.text: Increases Earth damage dealt by 20%, cumulable

description.name: Awoken Successor
description.text: Fire and Earth abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Fire and Earth abilities trigger 1 additional time

description.name: Twin Element Mode II (Fire, Earth)
description.text: Grants [Attach Fire with Stacking]/[Attach Earth with Stacking] after using a Fire/Earth ability
